title: Chance of earning the first fee
description: q: first-fee chance per eligible owner-month; n: need; p: qualified request given need; alpha: contractual fee earned given a qualified request.
source: Objais Revenue Model.tex; monthly need extension

title: One-visit contribution per acquired owner
description: C/A is group contribution per acquired owner, with fee reversals and processing deducted before multiplying by payment chance, then owner service and acquisition deducted. Numerical result minus 2.40 euros, before overhead.
source: Objais Revenue Model.tex; minimal one-visit model

title: Maximum advertising cost per click
description: 5 percent requests per entry click times 50 percent payable requests times 18 euros retained per paid lead, less 0.10 euros other cost per click, leaves 0.35 euros for advertising.
source: Objais Funnels Advertising Metrics and UX Research.md; acquisition limits

title: Retention before and after the first fee
description: E waits for a first fee; M has already earned Objais a fee; L is new paid leads. At 80 percent continuation, next month has 720 waiting owners and 80 completed owners, without dormancy or reset.
formula: E_next = ρ_E × (E − L); M_next = ρ_M × (M + L)

title: From monthly results to contribution per owner
description: Sum all monthly group contributions at a one percent monthly discount, then divide by the original cohort. Acquisition is already included once in month 1. Result 1.17 euros before fixed costs.
source: Objais Revenue Model.tex; equivalent finite V_H minus k

title: A new opportunity needs a genuine payment right
description: 80 percent continuation and 10 percent reset applied to 100 completed owners gives 8 newly eligible owners. Existing owner identity remains; another fee needs its own valid payment condition.

title: Renewal revenue at the first annual due date
description: For one original policy group at age 12 months: payment rights times 100 started policies times 98 percent monthly eligibility to power 12 times 15 euro renewal fee, earning 1177.08 euros before policy costs. Without rights, zero.
source: Objais Revenue Model.tex; one cohort annual renewal

title: Paid software follows its own billing clock
description: Software monthly contribution is paid-start share times original owners times billing continuation to age a times net price less extra account cost. Month 2 gives 356.25 euros, before acquisition, shared costs and fixed overhead.
source: Objais Revenue Model.tex; software cohort billing and extra account cost
